say:1:1131314001:1.text: The opportunity to land the order for a new statue, of course!
say:1:1131314001:1.source_cn: 当然是借此机会，拿下新雕像的订单！
say:1:1131314001:1.male: The opportunity to land the order for a new statue, of course!
say:1:1131314001:1.female: The opportunity to land the order for a new statue, of course!

say:2:1131314002:1.text: What are the chances of the Heroic Order finding the statue? No one knows.
say:2:1131314002:1.source_cn: 女神像靠骑士团能找回来吗？不一定。
say:2:1131314002:1.male: What are the chances of the Heroic Order finding the statue? No one knows.
say:2:1131314002:1.female: What are the chances of the Heroic Order finding the statue? No one knows.

say:3:1131314003:1.text: I already got the Stonemason Guild working on a replica while the Heroic Order is tied up with the investigation.
say:3:1131314003:1.source_cn: 我已经紧急联系了石匠公会，在骑士团焦头烂额的这段时间里...
say:3:1131314003:1.male: I already got the Stonemason Guild working on a replica while the Heroic Order is tied up with the investigation.
say:3:1131314003:1.female: I already got the Stonemason Guild working on a replica while the Heroic Order is tied up with the investigation.

say:4:1131314004:1.text: It's a move to reassure the people and boost the Mithril Consortium's image. A win-win situation!
say:4:1131314004:1.source_cn: 当然，这也是为了安抚人心，顺便打响秘银商会的招牌，可谓...
say:4:1131314004:1.male: It's a move to reassure the people and boost the Mithril Consortium's image. A win-win situation!
say:4:1131314004:1.female: It's a move to reassure the people and boost the Mithril Consortium's image. A win-win situation!

say:5:1131314005:1.text: As a professional trader, I have astute business acumen.
say:5:1131314005:1.source_cn: 这就是我作为专业贸易员的商业嗅觉。
say:5:1131314005:1.male: As a professional trader, I have astute business acumen.
say:5:1131314005:1.female: As a professional trader, I have astute business acumen.
